download_mingw: download a specific version of MinGW compiler for a given architecture and threading model
parse_repository: parse the mingw-builds repository file to get available compiler versions and configurations
find_7zip: locate the 7zip executable on the system via PATH or Windows registry
unpack_archive: unpack a mingw-builds archive to a specified location using 7zip
find_in_path: search for an executable file in the system PATH directories
